fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.35.0 replaces the furniture-only CumOverlays repair with one common RaceMenu body-relink pipeline for both free-standing and physical-furniture scenes. On each CumOverlays state change, OStim Together now asks RaceMenu to process BodyUpdate, OverlayUpdate and NodeOverride in its native order, then reapplies the authoritative overlay material state. This targets the actual failure observed in testing: Body [OvlN] could remain bound to an incorrect body geometry across scene transitions (2053 vertices / 19 matrices instead of the correct 18436 / 49), leaving valid textures and alpha invisible. The common relink also supersedes the historical delayed proxy RemoveOverlays/AddOverlays path. PPA synchronization, scene anchors and OCum equip meshes are unchanged.
